description: Veralto Corporation's unifying purpose is Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources, and its diverse group of leading operating companies provides essential technology solutions that monitor, enhance and protect key resources around the globe. It is committed to the advancement of public health and safety and believes it is positioned to support its customers as they address large global challenges including environmental resource sustainability, water scarcity, management of severe weather events, food and pharmaceutical security, and the impact of an aging workforce. For decades it has used its scientific expertise and innovative technologies to address complex challenges its customers face across regulated industries including municipal utilities, food and beverage, pharmaceutical and industrials where the consequence of failure is high, through its core offerings in water analytics, water treatment, marking and coding, and packaging and color. It was incorporated in Delaware in 2023 in connection with the separation of Veralto from Danaher Corporation on September 30, 2023 as an independent, publicly traded company listed on the New York Stock Exchange, and at the time of the separation Veralto consisted of Danaher's former Environmental & Applied Solutions segment, and it is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts with approximately 56 percent of its 2025 sales derived from customers outside the United States.
